description: Fresh post-Q5-tuning external blind compatibility benchmark for KOMPOSOS. Pair identities are separate from audit/blind_test_pairs.json, audit/ground_truth/*.json, prior audit/external_blind/*.json files, and audit/dev_compatibility/*.json.
selection_policy: Thirty-five source-backed pairs selected from external papers, standards, handbooks, and public technical databases. Labels are evidence-backed compatibility outcomes, not outputs from KOMPOSOS. This file must not be used for bridge tuning; misses should define a separate development set before any successor blind benchmark is reported.
holdout_policy: Freeze with SHA256 before first diagnostic run. Do not change scorer logic against this file. If results are inspected and used for development, treat this benchmark as spent for future blind claims and freeze a new benchmark.

schema.expected_compatible: true means the pair is reported as usable/stable/standard under the cited context; false means reported incompatibility, decomposition, severe corrosion, immiscibility, or unsuitable direct interface.

pairs.citation: Morita et al., Journal of Power Sources 2001, aluminum corrosion in LiTFSI electrolyte
pairs.evidence_basis: LiTFSI electrolytes can corrode bare aluminum current collectors without protective additives, so aluminum/LFP collector service is not a default compatible combination here.

pairs.citation: A review of current collectors for lithium-ion batteries, Journal of Power Sources 2021
pairs.evidence_basis: Copper remains the conventional low-potential current collector for graphite negative electrodes, including LiTFSI-based cells.

pairs.citation: Mikolajczak et al., Lithium-Ion Batteries Hazard and Use Assessment, Springer 2011, tab and collector materials
pairs.evidence_basis: Nickel tab hardware is standard Li-ion cell interconnect hardware and is compatible as a connector rather than as a collector foil.

pairs.citation: Zhang, Journal of Power Sources 2006, copper dissolution at high positive potentials in Li-ion batteries
pairs.evidence_basis: Copper is unsuitable for high-potential positive-electrode collector service because it oxidizes and dissolves at cathode potentials.

pairs.citation: A review of current collectors for lithium-ion batteries, Journal of Power Sources 2021
pairs.evidence_basis: Aluminum is not the standard low-potential collector for silicon negative electrodes; this role is conventionally served by copper.

pairs.citation: Tarascon and Armand, Nature 2001, issues and challenges facing rechargeable lithium batteries
pairs.evidence_basis: PVDF has been used broadly as an electrode binder, including silicon-containing negative-electrode composites.

pairs.citation: Small things make big deal: powerful binders of lithium batteries and post-lithium batteries, Energy Storage Materials 2019
pairs.evidence_basis: Fluoropolymer binders are chemically robust in layered-oxide lithium-ion cathode composites.

pairs.citation: Bresser et al., Energy & Environmental Science 2018, binder selection by electrode chemistry
pairs.evidence_basis: CMC is primarily an anode-binder family and is not a default cathode-binder choice for layered oxide positive electrodes.

pairs.citation: Bresser et al., Energy & Environmental Science 2018, binder selection by electrode chemistry
pairs.evidence_basis: SBR is associated with aqueous anode-binder systems and is not a default cathode-binder choice for oxide positive electrodes.

pairs.citation: Small things make big deal: powerful binders of lithium batteries and post-lithium batteries, Energy Storage Materials 2019
pairs.evidence_basis: Fluoropolymer binders are used in battery composite electrodes and can serve as chemically robust anode-side binders.

pairs.citation: Hansen, Hansen Solubility Parameters: A User's Handbook, CRC Press
pairs.manual_source: Hansen, Hansen Solubility Parameters: A User's Handbook, CRC Press
pairs.evidence_basis: NMP is the standard processing solvent for PVDF electrode-binder slurries.

pairs.citation: Hansen, Hansen Solubility Parameters: A User's Handbook, CRC Press
pairs.manual_source: Hansen, Hansen Solubility Parameters: A User's Handbook, CRC Press
pairs.evidence_basis: Polystyrene dissolves readily in toluene and is a standard solvent/polymer compatibility pair.

pairs.citation: Hansen, Hansen Solubility Parameters: A User's Handbook, CRC Press
pairs.manual_source: Hansen, Hansen Solubility Parameters: A User's Handbook, CRC Press
pairs.evidence_basis: PMMA is a standard solvent-compatible acrylic polymer for acetone-based processing and cleaning contexts.

pairs.citation: Utracki, Polymer Blends Handbook, Springer
pairs.evidence_basis: LCP/PEEK belongs to the family of high-performance engineering polymer blends used for thermal and mechanical property tuning.

pairs.citation: PolymerDatabase.com, polymer blend compatibility and polarity mismatch notes
pairs.evidence_basis: Polypropylene and nylon 66 are immiscible without compatibilization because of severe polarity mismatch.

pairs.citation: ASM Handbook Vol. 6, Welding, Brazing, and Soldering; dissimilar metal joining guidance
pairs.manual_source: ASM Handbook Vol. 6, Welding, Brazing, and Soldering, ASM International
pairs.evidence_basis: Silver and stainless steel can be joined in dry service using conventional engineered joining practice.

pairs.citation: Copper Development Association, copper alloy families and joining guidance
pairs.evidence_basis: Silver and brass are workable conductive hardware partners in dry service assemblies.

pairs.citation: ASM Handbook Vol. 6, Welding, Brazing, and Soldering; noble and copper-base joining guidance
pairs.manual_source: ASM Handbook Vol. 6, Welding, Brazing, and Soldering, ASM International
pairs.evidence_basis: Gold and copper are standard conductive hardware materials in controlled dry-service assemblies.

pairs.citation: ASM Handbook Vol. 6, Welding, Brazing, and Soldering; lead-tin solder systems
pairs.manual_source: ASM Handbook Vol. 6, Welding, Brazing, and Soldering, ASM International
pairs.evidence_basis: Lead and tin are a standard same-system solder pairing.

pairs.citation: ASM Handbook Vol. 13B, Corrosion: Materials, galvanic corrosion guidance
pairs.manual_source: ASM Handbook Vol. 13B, Corrosion: Materials, ASM International
pairs.evidence_basis: Zinc is strongly anodic relative to platinum and is galvanically incompatible in conductive wet environments.

pairs.citation: Kingery, Bowen, and Uhlmann, Introduction to Ceramics, 2nd edition
pairs.evidence_basis: Aluminum nitride and spinel are compatible ceramic families for thermal-management and electrically insulating composite contexts.

pairs.citation: Janek and Zeier, Nature Energy 2016, solid electrolyte interfaces in all-solid-state batteries
pairs.evidence_basis: Nitride and sulfide solid-electrolyte-style ceramic interfaces are chemically and mechanically mismatched without dedicated interlayers.

pairs.citation: Kingery, Bowen, and Uhlmann, Introduction to Ceramics, 2nd edition
pairs.evidence_basis: Boron carbide and silicon nitride belong to compatible hard refractory ceramic families used in engineered wear-resistant composites.

pairs.citation: Hench, Journal of the American Ceramic Society 1998, bioceramics and bioactive glasses
pairs.manual_source: Hench, J. Am. Ceram. Soc. 81(7), 1998; bioactive glass and calcium-phosphate composite systems
pairs.evidence_basis: Tricalcium phosphate and bioactive glass are established biomedical ceramic composite partners.

pairs.citation: Jaffe, Cook, and Jaffe, Piezoelectric Ceramics, Academic Press
pairs.manual_source: Jaffe, Cook, and Jaffe, Piezoelectric Ceramics, Academic Press
pairs.evidence_basis: Alumina and barium titanate are compatible oxide ceramics in multilayer dielectric and substrate assemblies under controlled processing.

pairs.citation: Adachi, Properties of Semiconductor Alloys: Group-IV, III-V and II-VI Semiconductors, 2009
pairs.evidence_basis: GaAs and GaP are same-family III-V semiconductors used in heterostructure and optoelectronic design contexts.

pairs.citation: Adachi, Properties of Semiconductor Alloys: Group-IV, III-V and II-VI Semiconductors, 2009
pairs.evidence_basis: GaP and InP are standard III-V semiconductor platform materials used in engineered heterostructure contexts.

pairs.citation: Wang et al., Nature Nanotechnology 2012, electronics and optoelectronics of two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenides
pairs.evidence_basis: Two-dimensional dichalcogenides such as MoS2 can form viable van der Waals heterostructures with nitride semiconductor platforms.

pairs.citation: Adachi, Properties of Semiconductor Alloys: Group-IV, III-V and II-VI Semiconductors, 2009
pairs.evidence_basis: Same-family III-V chemistry is not sufficient when lattice and process mismatch are too large for direct default compatibility.

pairs.citation: Morkoc, Handbook of Nitride Semiconductors and Devices, 2008
pairs.evidence_basis: Nitride and phosphide semiconductor platforms are not a default direct heterostructure match because their crystal chemistry and growth windows differ strongly.

pairs.citation: SCHOTT optical glass data sheets and borosilicate glass catalog
pairs.evidence_basis: Crown optical glass and borosilicate glass are compatible controlled-process optical assembly materials.

pairs.citation: SCHOTT optical glass data sheets and optical glass catalog
pairs.evidence_basis: Lanthanum crown and lead-containing optical glass families are practical adhesive or optical-contact assembly materials.

pairs.citation: Shelby, Introduction to Glass Science and Technology, 2nd edition
pairs.evidence_basis: Bioactive silicate glass and laboratory borosilicate glass have different chemistry and processing behavior for direct compatible fusion.

pairs.citation: Shelby, Introduction to Glass Science and Technology, 2nd edition
pairs.evidence_basis: Lead-containing crystal and quartz glass have strongly mismatched chemistry and thermal behavior for direct compatible fusion.

pairs.citation: Shelby, Introduction to Glass Science and Technology, 2nd edition
pairs.evidence_basis: Display-grade aluminosilicate and soda-lime float glass have different thermal and processing windows for direct compatible fusion.
